# UxPlay source provenance

- Upstream: <https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay>
- Version label: 1.74 experimental
- Pinned commit: `3ca7526387e894d6848b84c209de361c3bedd1ec`
- License: GNU GPL v3; see `LICENSE`

Stem Studio changes the audio renderer so decoded PCM can be delivered to the
local live-window publisher without an RTP or UDP hop. The upstream source is
vendored so the exact AirPlay host can be rebuilt and redistributed together
with its corresponding GPL source.
